articles.title: Helldivers 2 switches over from GameGuard to Easy Anti-Cheat
articles.summary: While it's still unavailable in the UK along with some other Sony published games, Arrowhead have moved Helldivers 2 over to Easy Anti-Cheat. Read the full article on GamingOnLinux .

articles.title: Claude Code v2.1.304
articles.summary: Added decider: "person" to a mod's tool.check answer: only the permission dialog or a host's callback can approve the ask, and it is refused with the mod's reason where nobody can be asked.

articles.title: Re-Interlacing Bob Deinterlaced 480p
articles.summary: So as I’ve “warned” many times in this post: This “re-interlacing bob 480p” method SEEMS to work fine, but I’m not sure how this method would hold up after capturing an entire tape.

articles.title: Revolut outage disrupts online banking operations worldwide
articles.summary: Since the incident began, thousands of users on the Downdetector outage tracking platform have reported issues with the Revolut app, mobile banking services, and transferring funds between accounts.

articles.title: Visualize Regular Expressions with Marbles
articles.summary: If you are one of those people who visualize things physically better than in the abstract, then Regex Marble Run by [bottomless] might be for you.

articles.title: WhatsApp may soon let iPhone users open any link in an in-app browser
articles.summary: After introducing limited in-app browser support for certain business links last year, WhatsApp is now working on expanding the feature to all links shared in chats.

articles.title: Require Police to Get a Warrant to Search ALPR Data
articles.summary: The best way to eliminate these abusive searches is to end ALPR mass surveillance. Where these systems remain, however, courts and state legislatures must require police to get a warrant before searching stored ALPR data.

articles.title: Here's some interesting Native Linux demos in Steam Next Fest Oct 26
articles.summary: For those of you who prefer games that have Native Linux versions, I've gone through Steam Next Fest - October 2026 edition to pick some out for you.

articles.title: GardenBench: A lightweight, daily evaluation of LLM capabilities
articles.summary: We introduce GardenBench, a benchmark with 11 test suites that evaluate the capabilities of Large Language Models (LLMs) across a range of tasks. By systematically prompting LLMs with various lightweight queries, we document day-to-day changes in model performance, including run costs and times, that other benchmarks miss.

articles.title: llm-tools-datasette 0.1.1
articles.summary: Release: llm-tools-datasette 0.1.1 When I switched LLM over to httpx2 in LLM 0.33 I forget that this would break any plugins which used httpx without directly depending on it.

articles.title: Tito’s Ultimate Atari Jaguar Upgrades
articles.summary: Zaxour released a bunch of upgrades for the motherboard that may be worth considering. There’s a power protection mod, as well as a full power circuit replacement, which can revive a Jaguar that’s been shorted out by using the wrong PSU.

articles.title: Wine ported to OpenBSD, runs modern Windows games
articles.summary: In what is quite a major achievement, Wine has been ported and made to work on OpenBSD. We have since tested several dozens of 64-bit Windows software, mostly successfully.

articles.title: Time-looping claymation puzzle-platformer UvsU: You vs You launches in January 2027
articles.summary: Claymation is something I love to see more of and we're getting a fun looking treat here with the upcoming puzzle-platformer UvsU: You vs You.

articles.title: Doing Less with More: A First-Principles Exploration of the Suitability of Agentic Computing over Alternative Architectural Choices
articles.summary: There is growing interest in automating business activities with Agentic Artificial Intelligence (AI) due to latter's seeming ease of use. Never has it been easier, or costlier, to do less with more.

articles.title: llm-echo 0.5
articles.summary: Release: llm-echo 0.5 I'm working towards a new LLM release, and testing PRs caused me to revisit the llm-echo debug plugin. This plugin provides a "model" which doesn't involve an LLM at all - it just repeats back the prompts that have been fed to it.

articles.title: RetroTINK 4K Pro – Lumacode, CRT Beam and IVTC Updates
articles.summary: Mike Chi has released some firmware updates, with more stable Lumacode support, optimizations and bugfixes for the 6x CE, 4K CE and 4K Pro. There were also some updates to Pro-only features like IVTC and CRT Beam Emulation BFI.

articles.title: Single-partition encrypted NetBSD 11 root
articles.summary: This is a quick overview which attempts to synthesize DW Armstrong’s tutorial on NetBSD encryption with the cgdroot page from the NetBSD wiki in a single MBR partition, divided into multiple disklabel slices to preserve MBR entries.

articles.title: A Controlled LLM Workflow for Evidence-Grounded Diagnosis of Risk Score Differences
articles.summary: We propose a controlled Large Language Model (LLM) workflow for explaining risk score differences using similar historical transactions. The workflow combines reference retrieval and contrastive SHapley Additive exPlanations (SHAP) evidence with reference-based LLM reasoning and deterministic validation.

articles.title: Copilot model policy API for enterprise, orgs, and teams
articles.summary: Together, these endpoints make it easier to manage Copilot model availability across your enterprise. Enterprise policies can delegate model control to organizations in organization mode, or to teams and apps in enterprise teams mode.

articles.title: GitHub Copilot models deprecated on October 19, 2026
articles.summary: As of today, October 19, 2026, we have deprecated the following models across most GitHub Copilot experiences (including Copilot Chat, inline edits, ask and agent modes, and code completions).

articles.title: Third RCs for macOS Sequoia 15.8.2 and macOS Tahoe 26.7.2 rolling out
articles.summary: In addition to macOS 27.2 Golden Gate RC 1, Apple is also rolling out the third RCs for macOS Sequoia 15.8.2 and macOS Tahoe 26.7.2.

articles.title: Grab Reduces ANRs by 32% and improves startup time by 35% with R8 and Profile guided optimization
articles.summary: To eliminate ANR’s and improve startup times, Grab implemented R8 optimizations, Baseline Profiles, and Startup Profiles. Profile guided optimization alongside the R8 optimizer delivered an immediate 12% cold start improvement from R8 and an additional 15% from Baseline Profiles—achieving a 27% faster startup time and effectively eliminating the post-release ANR spikes.

articles.title: Apple Seeds macOS Golden Gate 27.2 Release Candidate to Developers
articles.summary: Apple is testing the next macOS Golden Gate update, and developers can download the ‌macOS Golden Gate‌ 27.2 release candidate. The RC comes a week after Apple released the fourth beta.

articles.title: Apple Releases iOS 27.2 Release Candidate
articles.summary: Apple today seeded the release candidate of an upcoming iOS 27.2 update to developers for testing purposes, with the update coming a week after Apple released the fourth iOS 27.2 beta.

articles.title: BleachBit 6.0.6 released with fixes for admin cleaning on Linux
articles.summary: Elsewhere on Linux, issues running BleachBit as Administrator (a separate mode for cleaning system files) on RedHat were resolved by using pkexec . This is also recommended if using admin mode on Ubuntu with a .deb-installed build.
